bifrost: springboard/src/shell/photos/ (viewer, edit, slideshow, thumbs), springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs, springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs
summary: BifrOSt covers the viewing and editing side of ImageKit only inside shell apps (Photos viewer, edit mode and slideshow), a Quick Look preview model and thumbnail cache in the SDK, PDF reading and writing through the SDK document and writer wrappers, PNG and JPEG decode and encode, and PDF text extraction for Books. A pure typed DAG model now covers part of Quartz Composer; there is still no composition UI, renderer or plug-in host. No app-facing SDK API exists yet for image views, slideshows, Core Image filters, PDF outlines or selections.

features.note: Full-screen viewer with paging, pinch and double-tap zoom and pan, and a grid of thumbnails, all inside the Photos shell app. The zoom arithmetic, grid layout and viewer gestures are tested in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs. Gap: no SDK view for apps to embed an image view or browser.

features.feature: Image editing panel and save options (IKImageEditPanel, IKSaveOptions)
features.note: Edit mode does quarter-turn rotate, straighten, crop to aspect presets, brightness and contrast, and saves a copy (save_copy). The save options are a tested model (format, JPEG quality clamped to 0 to 1, name suffix, numbered names when a file is taken) in save_options. Gap: the save sheet is not wired to that model, and there is no edit panel for apps; the panel needs the shell and the lab machine.

Slide timing, cross-fade layers, pausing, stepping, the control timeout and the drift geometry are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: the slideshow lives in Photos only, with no SDK type and no screen saver hook.

features.feature: Core Image filters and filter browser (CIFilter, IKFilterBrowserView, IKFilterUIView)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-quartz, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Five fixed per-pixel colour filters (Original, Vivid, Mono, Noir, Warm). No filter graph, no parameterised CIFilter-style objects, no filter browser and no kernel or GPU image processing API.

features.feature: Camera device browser and picture taker (IKDeviceBrowserView, IKCameraDeviceView, IKPictureTaker)
features.note: Camera app has a live viewfinder, timer, QR scanner and last-photo thumbnail, opened by the shell only. No SDK device browser, picture-taker panel or camera download delegate. The camera stream is only touched while the app is open.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No scanner support: the only scanner hits in the tree are the camera QR decoder and unrelated text.

features.apple: IKImageView input (CGImage-backed image loading); no direct Quartz decode call in this framework
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs (detect, pixel_size, decode, encode, encode_jpeg); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (fit, cover, contain)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. The app-facing detect, decode, PNG and JPEG encode and their refusals are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. No app calls it yet.

features.feature: Quick Look preview panel (QLPreviewPanel, QLPreviewItem, QLPreviewPanelDataSource)
features.note: The SDK has the panel model: items, index clamp, step, toggle, show and close. Refreshed 2026-10-17: the shell draws the panel (springboard/src/shell/preview_panel.rs), opened by ToShell::Preview and the quick-look service. No app is adopted yet. Model tests (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs): the_panel_steps_without_wrapping_and_the_index_stays_in_range, a_pull_clamps_the_current_index_into_the_new_list, a_display_state_past_the_end_is_refused. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (request, reply, event, State, load_pixels); springboard/ui/src/thumb_service.rs (request and answer models)
features.note: Apps ask the thumbnails service for a picture of a file at a size and scale; the shell keeps a disk cache shared by all apps, answers pending requests with ready or failed events, and gives the type icon for files with no picture. The shell providers draw the pictures; there is no app-side generator and no update handlers. Tests (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs): a_picture_answer_names_the_cached_image_and_its_size, an_icon_answer_keeps_the_type_and_the_badge_and_pending_has_neither, a_failed_answer_carries_the_reason, only_the_thumbnail_events_of_the_thumbnail_service_are_read.

Wave 4 (theme-22, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests (preview_view_tests in sdk/src/peek.rs, and springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs: an_embedded_view_loads_a_new_item_until_the_app_reports_ready, without_autostart_an_embedded_item_waits_at_ready, a_refresh_needs_an_item_and_is_counted, closing_a_view_returns_its_item_and_resets_the_state, a_window_close_closes_the_view_only_when_the_switch_is_on); not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No embeddable preview view; the peek.rs gap list says the same.

features.feature: PDF document model (PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFOutline, PDFSelection)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (Document, search, Selection), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/doc.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/obj.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/extract.rs; tests sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: Apps can open a PDF, read the page count and sizes, and render a page through graphics_pdf::Document, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Gap: outline, selection and text extraction are not in the SDK; Books uses extract.rs directly. Built 2026-10-19 (w15-core-graphics): graphics_pdf::Document::search returns a Selection for every occurrence of a string (page, line, character range, text as written, baseline and size of the line) and Document::selection_text joins them, which is the PDFSelection a find bar highlights. Outline and page text were already in the SDK (outline, page_text, find). Selection rectangles along a line (x extents) and drag selection are not built because the extractor records a line's baseline and size but not its glyph positions. Midget check: run the sdk test graphics_pdf::tests::search_returns_each_occurrence_with_its_line_and_range on Midget; it writes a three-page PDF and reads the matches back.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf_view.rs (PdfViewState, thumbnail_grid); springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs (assemble, load, probe; reflow into the shared page model); wired: springboard/apps/books-desktop/src/books/mod.rs (Panel::Pages); tests springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: PDF text is reflowed into paragraphs, headings and images in the Books page model; headless tests in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs cover the reflow rules. Gap: no fixed-layout page view, thumbnail view, zoom or selection for apps; PDFCraft is a third-party upstream binary, not an SDK API, and needs a Midget check. Built 2026-10-19 (w15-core-graphics): springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf_view.rs is the page layout of a fixed-layout view for apps: PdfViewState lays out pages in single-page, continuous, two-up and two-up continuous display (with book mode), zoom in and out (0.1 to 8), automatic fit to width and height, current page and next and previous page, visible slots for a scroll offset, the page at the middle of the viewport, scroll offset for a page, and mapping between a view point and a page point (origin bottom left); thumbnail_size and thumbnail_grid lay out a thumbnail view. Pages are drawn by the app with Document::render. It holds no pixels and no selection yet. Midget check: run the sdk tests graphics_pdf_view::tests (continuous_pages_stack_with_a_gap_and_centre_in_the_viewport, auto_scaling_fits_the_width_and_follows_the_viewport, points_map_between_the_view_and_the_page, a_view_is_built_from_a_written_document) on Midget.

features.feature: PDF annotations and form widgets (PDFAnnotation, PDFAppearanceCharacteristics, PDFBorder, widgets)
features.apple: PDFAnnotation, PDFAction, PDFDestination, PDFAppearanceCharacteristics, PDFBorder; widget how-to articles
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-quartz, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The PDF engine reads no annotations or AcroForm fields. PDFCraft's annotation UI comes from the upstream binary and is not reachable from apps.

features.feature: PDF writing, print workflow and Quartz filters (QuartzFilter, QuartzFilterManager)
features.apple: QuartzFilter, QuartzFilterManager, QuartzFilterView, Quartz Filter Constants
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (PdfWriter, PdfPage, finish_filtered), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_quartz_filter.rs (QuartzFilter, QuartzFilterManager), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/writer.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs (PrintOperation, Destination::Pdf), springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (write_pdf); tests sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: PdfWriter creates files from pages of rectangles, lines and images, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Text in the four standard faces is built (PdfPage::draw_text, tests graphics_pdf::tests::text_is_drawn_as_hex_in_a_standard_face). Gap: no print-to-PDF filter pipeline and no QuartzFilter manager; Save as PDF in the print sheet still copies the file. Built 2026-10-19 (w15-core-graphics): springboard/sdk/src/graphics_quartz_filter.rs has QuartzFilter (a 3x3 colour matrix, a lightness shift and an image size limit) and QuartzFilterManager with the seven built-in names (Black & White, Blue Tone, Gray Tone, Lightness Decrease, Lightness Increase, Reduce File Size, Sepia Tone), add and remove for app filters, and PdfWriter::finish_filtered applies a filter while writing: every rg and RG colour of the page content is mapped and every raster image is scaled to the limit and colour-mapped. PdfPage also fills and strokes paths now (fill_path, stroke_path, fill_stroke_path). A filter does not rewrite a PDF that was read from elsewhere, and the print sheet still writes its job without one. Midget check: run the sdk tests graphics_quartz_filter::tests and graphics_pdf::tests::a_black_and_white_filter_greys_a_coloured_page and a_reduce_size_filter_shrinks_images_in_the_file on Midget.

features.feature: Quartz Composer compositions and custom patches (QCComposition, QCView, QCPlugIn, QCRenderer)
features.apple: QCComposition, QCCompositionLayer, QCView, QCRenderer, QCPlugIn, QCPlugInContext, QCCompositionRepository
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/patch_graph.rs (typed patches, validated connections, deterministic evaluation)
features.note: A pure typed DAG model validates port types, single-source inputs and cycles, then evaluates patches in dependency order with headless tests. It is not a Quartz Composer-compatible file/runtime, composition UI, renderer or plug-in host; deprecation status remains unverified.

gaps: No SDK image view or image browser for apps (ImageKit IKImageView and IKImageBrowserView); image viewing exists only inside the Photos shell app.
No parameterised image filter API (Core Image CIFilter) and no filter browser; Photos has five fixed colour filters.
No scanner support (IKScannerDeviceView) and no SDK camera device browser or picture taker.
The Quick Look panel model in springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs is drawn by the shell for ToShell::Preview (src/shell/preview_panel.rs), but no app adopts it; no QLPreviewView.

PDF selection is a find result only (graphics_pdf::Selection from Document::search: page, line, character range, baseline); no glyph-level rectangles or drag selection, and no pixels for a fixed-layout view (PdfViewState is the layout model only).
No PDF annotation or form widget support in the PDF engine, which reads no annotations or AcroForm fields; PDFCraft's annotation UI is not reachable from apps.
QuartzFilter applies only to PDFs the SDK writes (PdfWriter::finish_filtered); the print sheet's Save as PDF does not offer filters and no filter rewrites an existing PDF.
No Quartz Composer equivalent (QCComposition, QCView, custom patches).
